About_&_Key_Points:
About
Bohra Industries Ltd is a Udaipur-based listed company whose legacy activity is production /trading of Single Super Phosphate (SSP). Operations remain temporarily suspended.
[1]
Key Points
Current status vs legacy business:
[1]
The legacy business manufactured/traded powder and granulated SSP; the FY26 accounts still describe the operating activity as production/trading of SSP and locate the manufacturing plant in Udaipur.
However, operations were suspended in FY26, revenue from operations was nil and Q1 FY27 again reported nil revenue.
It is therefore an inactive asset base awaiting revival, not an active fertilizer producer.
